subject: [PATCH 3/5] mm/gup: add gup_fill_pages() and use it

2026-08-01.patch_summary: This patch adds a new helper function gup_fill_pages() to the Linux kernel's mm/gup.c file, which simplifies the process of filling pages in various follow functions (follow_huge_pud(), follow_huge_pmd(), and follow_page_pte_commit()). The new function replaces repeated code that stores the page found into pages[0] and flushes its caches. No functional changes are intended by this patch.
